sectiondef.header: Variables for 5s timer based on millis()
Variables for 10min alarm based on RTC
Date and time variables and RTC object instance

briefdescription.para: Prints the current time to the serial port (for debugging).
Initializes the RTC module and configures the first 10-minute alarm.

detaileddescription.para: Configures the RTC with initial date and time if necessary, or synchronizes it. This function must be called in 'setup()'.

briefdescription.para: Checks if 5 seconds have passed using millis(). If so, activates the alarma_5s flag.

simplesect.para: Must be called continuously in the main loop.

briefdescription.para: Reads data from all sensors and accumulates them for averaging.

detaileddescription.para: Calls the reading functions of the SEN55 and T6793 modules and adds their values to the corresponding sum_* accumulators. Increments the averaging counters.

briefdescription.para: Verifies if the 10-minute cycle has completed. If so, activates the alarma_10min flag.

detaileddescription.para:
Checks the RTC time to see if the next 10-minute interval has been reached (e.g., 12:10, 12:20).
Must be called continuously in the main loop.

briefdescription.para: Processes accumulated data to calculate averages and stores them.

detaileddescription.para: This function is called at the end of each averaging period (e.g., every 10 minutes) and the averages are stored in the corresponding avg_* variables.

briefdescription.para: Implementation of functions for alarm management and data averaging.
